chunks: And in the narration of Ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, he said: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said:
Ali عليه السلام, when a man died and had a slave woman as his wife, would purchase her from his wealth, then free her, and then grant her inheritance.

key_terms.امْرَأَةٌ مَمْلُوكَةٌ: a wife who is legally enslaved

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali عليه السلام deal with the inheritance of a slave wife when her husband died?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a legal practice attributed to Imam Ali عليه السلام regarding a deceased man whose wife was a slave woman. He would buy her from the estate, free her, and then allow her to inherit, indicating a ruling connected to the inheritance of enslaved spouses.
